_about: Fixed terminology for HU<->EN translation. Claude reads this before every translation; edit it when a proofreading correction should apply everywhere.
rules: Personal names follow each language's order: HU 'Fazekas Ábel', EN 'Ábel Fazekas'. Exception: names of non-Hungarians keep their own order in both.
Book titles are never translated in running text. On the EN site show the Hungarian title, with the English gloss (title_en) in italics beneath or in brackets.
Proper names of organisations, venues and projects stay as they are (Kijárat Kiadó, PAIKKA, HANGZAVART?, Fresh Fabrik, HIBIKI, neurodiverz.xyz).
Funder statements use the funder's own official wording where one exists; do not paraphrase them.

terms.en: I.T.E.M. Kulturális és Oktatási Alapítvány (I.T.E.M. Cultural and Educational Foundation)
terms.note: No registered foreign-language name. First mention on a page: full HU name + gloss; afterwards 'the I.T.E.M. Foundation' / 'the Foundation'.
